invariants.rationale: If result is null, defaultValue must have been returned (which could also be null). Otherwise, result is non-null.
If result was the defaultValue, type cast isn't enforced; otherwise, result is an instance of clazz.
A null key is unlikely to be valid per API contract.
If result was not the defaultValue, it is non-null.
If not defaultValue, result is from map and must cast to clazz.
